integrity.author_provenance: Not attributed to an external author.
integrity.independent_review: No independent validation has been carried out.
integrity.reproducibility: Exact mathematical proof and standalone finite-dimension NumPy/SciPy regression program included.
integrity.scientific_claim: Exact all-dimension bright/dark dimensions and exact every-vertex loss probability under positive heterogeneous first-shell rates.

scientific_limitations: Finite, single-excitation Boolean hypercubes with uniform positive hopping and positive irreversible loss at every Hamming-weight-one vertex only.
No stroboscopic measurement protocol, site-energy disorder, local dephasing, or many-particle dynamics.
Only infinite-time absorption probabilities and dark-space dimensions are established, not finite-time convergence rates.
Unlocated implicit consequences of broader controllability or Fourier-spectral results remain a scientific-priority risk.
title: Exact absorption by the first Hamming shell of a quantum hypercube
